effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] If you have a green Tamer in play, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon becomes suspended, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
